prompt:
Style: a hand-painted digital background painting for a story-driven 2D adventure game, made as one single still image that will later be brought to life with subtle animated layers (moving water, drifting clouds, flickering lights). Technique: painted with soft round and flat digital brushes, brush marks visible but calm, few large strokes; shapes simplified into large, clear, readable masses with distinct, clean edges between sky, land and water; soft painted shading; gentle atmospheric perspective (the distant headland and the open sea soft and slightly hazy, the quay in the foreground a little darker and crisper). Moderate detail: no fine noise, no tiny clutter, no fine rigging; each mast is a single clean stroke. Limited, harmonious dusk palette: deep blue-violet and slate blue in the sky and the sea, a warm apricot-orange band at the horizon, warm yellow-orange accents only at the lit window, the lantern and the lighthouse lamp. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not glossy CGI, not a saturated postcard sunset, not an oil painting with thick impasto, not a cartoon with ink outlines, no cel shading.

Layout for animation: the picture consists of clearly separated areas. A large open sky fills the upper two fifths of the picture, with a few soft, layered, horizontal cloud banks and clear gaps with small, sharp first stars. A large calm area of open water fills the middle of the picture, with long, soft vertical reflections of the lights and of the orange horizon band and a few thin horizontal ripple lines; the edges where the water meets the quay, the jetty and the boats are clean and readable. Camera: slightly raised eye level looking across the harbour; the horizon is straight and level at about 45 % of the picture height. The cottage stands in the left fifth of the picture; the top of its chimney is seen against open sky, with nothing behind or directly above it. The lantern post stands on the quay at about one quarter of the picture width. The short wooden jetty with the two boats is in the centre; the two boats lie side by side on open water, each surrounded by water, not overlapping each other, with no posts or ropes in front of them. The lighthouse on its rocky headland stands at about four fifths of the picture width; its lamp is seen against open sky, with clear sky to its left and right. The stone quay fills the bottom quarter of the picture as a wide, plain, readable stone surface; the barrels, the crates and the rope coil stand on the left near the cottage, while the middle and the right part of the quay are plain stone without any props (a character will stand there, and a text box will cover the lower right). Keep the top tenth and the bottom tenth of the picture free of important details, because the picture will be cropped to a wide 16:9 screen.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

Animated effects are added later as separate layers, so do not paint them: the lighthouse lamp is only a small glowing spot without any beam, rays or light cone; there is no smoke at all from the chimney; there are no birds or seagulls in the sky; no light rays, god rays, lens flare or bloom anywhere. The lit window and the iron lantern are small, bright, warm spots with a small soft glow and a modest warm light pool on the nearby wall and stones.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Style: one single character painted in exactly the same hand-painted digital painting technique, palette and dusk light as the second attached image, which is a harbour background painting: soft round and flat digital brushes, brush marks visible but calm, simplified readable shapes, soft painted shading, muted dusk colours with warm accents, no dark outlines. The second attached image is only a style reference: do not paint its harbour, sky, water or any other part of its scene. The first attached image only shows the character design: take over the costume, the colours and the body proportions, but not its clean cartoon line style, its flat colours or its dark outlines; repaint the character completely in the painting technique of the second image, so that he can stand inside that painting without looking pasted in. Not line art, no cel shading, not a 3D render, not a plush toy, not a photograph.

The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.

Pose and layout: exactly one full-body figure, centred, standing calmly upright on both feet with both soles on the same level, in a slight three-quarter view turned a little towards the left side of the picture, looking at the viewer; both eyes open and clearly visible, mouth closed, arms hanging relaxed, the parcel held under one arm. The figure fills about 85 % of the image height, with a small empty margin above the cap and below the feet. The long free end of the red scarf is lifted by a light sea wind and blows out towards the right side of the picture: it hangs in the air beside the body, with a clear gap of empty background between the scarf end and the body, and it does not overlap the vest, the arms or the parcel (it will be animated later). Light: warm orange lantern light from the left side of the picture as a soft warm rim on the left edges of the figure, cool blue dusk light from above and from the right; cap and vest clearly dark green, shirt cream, scarf red, the black-and-white stripes of the face clearly readable. A clean, closed silhouette with crisp edges: no loose brush strokes, paint splatter, sparkles, mist or glow around the figure, no motion blur. Isolated on a fully transparent background, no ground, no cast shadow, no frame.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: portrait 2:3.

Turn the attached painting into a flat colour-coded segmentation map for an animation tool. Keep the composition, the outlines, the positions and the proportions of the attached image exactly, as if traced on a clear sheet laid on top of it: the same framing, the same horizon height, the same size and place of every object. Replace every area by one flat, pure, fully saturated colour with hard, clean edges: no shading, no texture, no brush strokes, no outlines, no gradients, no glow, no halos, no details inside the areas. It is a technical map, not a picture: do not keep any colour of the attached painting, use only the colour codes below. Colour codes: the whole sky including all clouds and stars, down to the horizon: pure blue #0000FF. All open water of the sea and the harbour, including every reflection on the water: pure cyan #00FFFF. The two fishing boats including hulls, cabins and masts: pure magenta #FF00FF. The lit window of the cottage: pure yellow #FFFF00. The glass of the iron lantern on the wooden post: pure orange #FF8000. The glowing lamp at the top of the lighthouse: pure red #FF0000. The chimney of the cottage: pure green #00FF00. Everything else (land, rocks, the headland, the cottage walls and roof, the lighthouse tower, the quay, the jetty and its posts, barrels, crates, rope, the lantern post): pure black #000000. Use no other colours, and do not add, remove or move any object.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
ref_note: Use the attached image only for composition, outlines and positions; do not keep its colours or painting style.
